_selection.seat_incumbents: All four models registry/SEATS.md names exist in the catalogue and are all pinned, because closing those four seat assignments is the point of the battery.

_judge_note: Outside the roster by construction — the harness refuses to let a model grade its own output. Cheap ($0.40/$1.60 per M) and reliable at short JSON rubrics. Used only by P5 and P7, the two probes whose pass criteria are genuinely semantic.

_cost_estimate._method: Measured token shape, not a guess: skill-edition system prompt ~4.2K tokens, mechanics-card ~0.4K; P6 is 4 turns and P7 is 2, both resending their prefix. ~49.5K input + ~3.8K output per model per run.
_cost_estimate.ceiling: budget_usd in run_request.json. The harness accumulates usage.cost and aborts on crossing it, keeping partial results.
_cost_estimate.caveat: deepseek-r1 bills reasoning tokens as output; its real cost may run several times the line estimate. The ceiling is what actually bounds this, not the estimate.
